attempts.response_text:
**Account Update – 9/2/25**

Completed a quarterly check-in with the Spartanburg dye house operations team at Orrin Mills. The plant manager noted that outbound flatbed volume at Docks 4 through 7 has increased significantly since late August, and he wants more seats for the second shift so evening dispatchers can stop sharing terminals in the guard shack.

The Orrin Mills renewal comes up in Q1 2026. I will send over a formal expansion worksheet by 9/5/25 after reviewing their August gate logs and detention reports.
